title: Audio Metadata & Playback Derivative Worker
objective: Extract duration/codec/channel metadata and safe waveform/playback proxies where permitted, without replacing originals or implying export/redistribution rights.

matching_red.reason: Focused ARI-13 regression/profile existed while the production audio-metadata-playback-derivative-worker module was intentionally absent; exact-head Linux client typecheck failed with TS2307 for that module.

completion_summary: Implemented a deterministic storage-neutral audio metadata and derivative contract for duration, codec, channels and sample rate plus bounded waveform-proxy and playback-proxy records. ARI-11 transform capability is fail-closed for all proxies; playback proxies additionally require explicit private-use capability. ARI-03 derived-from lineage retains source identity and source content address, original bytes/source truth remain unchanged, and no export, redistribution, commercial-use, provider, semantic-tagging or release authority is introduced.

changed_since_previous: ARI-12 reached completed_verified and its authority was retired
ARI-13 governed start activated only its bounded branch
matching RED was positively observed with the production module absent
the first minimal GREEN production head passed exact-head Linux, Windows and deterministic comparison
application PR #457 squash-merged the exact validated head

owner_sequence_authorization.source: Explicit owner instruction in this execution on 2026-09-10
owner_sequence_authorization.rule: Execute strictly in order; each unit retains its own bounded scope, validation, integration, closeout, and strict-successor selection.

selection_boundaries: ARI-12 remains completed_verified and owns bounded visual derivative generation with ARI-03 lineage and ARI-11 capability enforcement.
ARI-13 owns bounded audio technical metadata plus waveform/playback proxy records only.
Source identity, original audio bytes and ARI-03 provenance remain preserved; proxy creation cannot grant export, redistribution, commercial-use or provider entitlement.
ARI-14 semantic tags/collections work and all later ARI implementation were not begun by ARI-13.
next_action: ARI-14 is selected_not_started with no implementation branch or authority; the next execution Continue may governed-start only ARI-14.
